papers.title: Reproducibility is Not Enough: Artifact Verifiability in Decentralized-Build Package Ecosystems
papers.mapped_support: Artifact verification also requires recoverable source revision, build environment, dependencies and build instructions; reproducibility alone is insufficient.
papers.does_not_support: It does not prove that this BLAKE3/RMR repository or any artifact is reproducible or verifiable.

papers.title: An Evidence-driven Protocol for Trustworthy CI Pipelines
papers.mapped_support: A CI evidence lifecycle can bind deterministic builds to attestations under an explicit trust model.
papers.does_not_support: TEE/Nix/TDX results do not transfer automatically to GitHub Actions, Termux, ARMv7 or the RMR implementation.

papers.title: Kettle: Attested Builds for Verifiable Software Provenance
papers.mapped_support: Attested provenance can bind source commit, dependencies, toolchain, build environment and artifact digests.
papers.does_not_support: A digest or ordinary CI record alone does not prove the stated build process; no Kettle/TEE execution occurred here.

papers.title: Witnessd: Proof-of-Process via Adversarial Collapse
papers.mapped_support: Digital signatures and hashes bind data or key possession but do not by themselves establish human authorship or process integrity.
papers.does_not_support: Its proposed proof-of-process mechanism was not implemented or tested in RMR.

papers.title: Revision-Bound Evidence Cuts: Authenticated Queries and Contextual Witness Capacity
papers.mapped_support: Authenticated sources can still be recombined into unsupported claims; revision and qualification boundaries must be preserved.
papers.does_not_support: Its domain results do not validate BLAKE3 performance, authorship, custody completeness or implementation correctness.

papers.title: Computer Science Conferences Should Require Nonrepudiable Experimental Results
papers.mapped_support: Reported numerical results should be bound to an observed computation by a tamper-evident record.
papers.does_not_support: This position paper and its reference implementation do not establish that any RMR benchmark was executed.

papers.title: Agent Flight Recorder: Tamper-Evident Audit Trails with On-Chain Anchoring for Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
papers.mapped_support: Canonical events, predecessor hashes, intent/execution/effect separation and external anchoring can improve tamper evidence and auditability.
papers.does_not_support: A hash chain preserves integrity of recorded events, not completeness or truth of unrecorded events; no on-chain anchor is proposed for this change.

architecture_gate.acceptance: Promote only the exact claim whose required fields and exact environment are present.
architecture_gate.fail_closed: Missing identity, source, authority, execution target, evidence rule or predecessor remains a typed TOKEN_VAZIO.

typed_voids.next_gate: Execute exact-head BLAKE3 KAT and RMR adapter tests with command, environment, binary hash and logs.
Compare base commit to the declared upstream baseline without modifying upstream cryptographic logic.
Rebuild and rerun on an independent equivalent host; bind outputs to exact source and toolchain.
Run the exact artifact on identified physical devices and record scoped receipts.
Perform file-by-file commit and license review; do not infer authorship from a digest.

rollback.procedure: Close the isolated branch or revert only the additive documentation commit; preserve Supabase S1 and append a successor correction.

F_ok: Canonical BLAKE3/RMR repository, exact base commit and reviewed blobs fixed.
Pre-research Supabase gate persisted and read back.
Seven alphaXiv sources mapped with explicit support and non-support boundaries.
F_gap: No BLAKE3/RMR execution in this tranche.
No independent rebuild or physical ARM device evidence.
No authorship, universal performance, custody completeness or scientific-truth promotion.
F_next: Create successor Supabase receipt bound to this Git commit.
Run exact-head KAT/negative tests under a separate execution gate.
Request human review before any merge or claim promotion.
